nova.equilibrium.connectivity_boundary._arg_extreme (connectivity_boundary.py:136-194, 59 lines) with _argmax_exact and _argmin_exact (3 lines each): a superset, adding relative_tolerance, candidate_index and NaN handling

Both exact wrappers also agree on a 1-D slice (maximum index 6, minimum index 4). Raising one element of the second implementation's input row 7.0 past the previous maximum moves its chosen index and leaves the first unchanged, a gap of 1 against a tolerance of 0.
context.removal: stencil_nulls' _arg_extreme (22), _argmax_exact (3) and _argmin_exact (3) become removable if stencil_nulls imports the connectivity_boundary owner. The owner is already a strict superset, so the exact-only callers keep their behaviour by calling it without a tolerance.
